description: Aggregate codon-usage statistics for a coding sequence (counts, RSCU, ENC + isEncCalculable, GC1/GC2/GC3, GC3s, overall GC); gc_convention EmbossCusp (default, stops included) or CodonW (stops excluded); opt-in CodonW Fop and CBI (include_fop_cbi, fop_cbi_organism, optimal_codons).

genetic_code.description: NCBI translation table number defining synonymous families and stops (default 1 = Standard).

gc_convention.description: Convention for GC1/GC2/GC3 and overall GC: EmbossCusp (all codons, stops included; EMBOSS cusp) or CodonW (stop codons of genetic_code excluded; CodonW gc_out).

include_fop_cbi.description: Also compute CodonW 1.4.4 Fop (Ikemura 1981) and CBI (Bennetzen & Hall 1982); false = fop/cbi null.

fop_cbi_organism.description: CodonW built-in optimal-codon set (-f_type); case/spaces ignored, 'E. coli' style accepted.

optimal_codons.description: User optimal codons (DNA/RNA, any case; CodonW -fop_file/-cbi_file); overrides fop_cbi_organism.

enc.description: Effective Number of Codons (20..61; 0 = not calculable, see effective_number_of_codons).

isEncCalculable.description: false when ENC cannot be calculated (CodonW *****).

gc3s.description: GC% at third position of synonymous codons.

fop.description: CodonW Fop = optimal/total over amino acids with >1 codon and an optimal codon; null unless include_fop_cbi and calculable.

cbi.description: CodonW CBI = (optimal - expected)/(total - expected); null unless include_fop_cbi and calculable.
